SELECT
  strftime(t0.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  t0.email_count AS emails_logged,
  (DATE '2026-01-05' - t0.month_start) AS days_old_as_of_2026_01_05,
  CASE WHEN (DATE '2026-01-05' - t0.month_start) > 730 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS exceeds_730_day_retention
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t1.created_at)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS email_count
  FROM email_log t1
  WHERE t1.created_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND t1.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t1.created_at)
) t0
ORDER BY t0.month_start ASC
note: Platform-wide monthly counts from email_log.created_at, Jan 2023–Dec 2025 (36 rows). "Days old" is measured from each month's start to 2026-01-05 as requested, so the flag is conservative (actual oldest/newest rows within a month could differ by up to ~30 days).
